title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas compressible NS and reference coefficients are implemented; report.tex:20–24 gives nondimensional equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:508–516 reads CGNS on root and distributes METIS mesh; mesh_np1/2/8 tests passed in clean restricted build.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based conservative residual with wall treatment exists; M080 restart-origin cases show only0.569/0.371 residual orders and limited long-tail convergence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: HLLC, Rusanov fallback and stationary wall flux paths exist; report lists per-case choices and limitations.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Stationary-wall/farfield paths and solver.cpp:1084–1088 explicit zero no-slip wall velocities are present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares, Barth limiter and pressure-jump shock flattening are implemented and reconstruction tests pass; temporal production binary cannot be rehashed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter, positivity safeguards and shock sensor source exist; clean reconstruction test passes, with no independent production rerun.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Immutable report.tex:24 states integrated viscous split is tangential. physics.cpp:449–458 forms full tau·n and solver.cpp:1054–1064 integrates both traction components; only surface cf at :1078–1083 projects tangentially. Historical source checkpoint be1f6b0 matches curated solver/src. Normal contribution and executable hash are not independently quantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Stationary-wall 4x4 block implicit source exists; documented CFL caps and short restart-origin plateau evidence limit universal convergence claims.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1862–1872 tests the strict total-residual ratio; Re200 metadata reports last0.000986228 vs0.001, zero misses, and force/spectrum support shedding. Exact historic binary is unavailable.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Fresh np1/np8 Re20 step3716 Cd agree to ~4e−15; NACA M015 step6397 Cd agree to ~7.5e−12. Starts match, but historical binary cannot be rehashed.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
